markdownArticle.content:
# Best Answering Service for Small Businesses: Complete Guide

The best answering service for small businesses is designed to handle every call, day or night, following your specific script and rules. It can book appointments, send follow-up messages, and log each conversation, ensuring you never miss important details or potential new business.

Published by Revo, which sells an AI receptionist for home service businesses. Reviewed November 10, 2026.

## How Calls Are Answered
When a customer calls your business, the AI receptionist answers using your preferred greeting and follows your instructions for common questions. It speaks in both English and Spanish, making sure every caller feels understood. This approach ensures your business sounds professional, even when you are unavailable.

## Booking and Follow-Up
The AI receptionist can book appointments directly into your calendar or field service software if connected. After the call, it sends a confirmation text to the customer and logs a summary for your records. This keeps your schedule organized and your customers informed without extra effort from your team.

## Keeping You in the Loop
Every call is logged with a summary, so you can review what was discussed and follow up if needed. Some plans allow for call transfers, recordings, and transcripts, giving you more visibility and control over your customer interactions. This helps you stay on top of your business, even when you are on the job.

## Where Revo fits
Revo answers the calls you forward to it, 24/7, and follows your script and rules. It books appointments, sends SMS follow-up and logs a summary of every call. On Crew and Fleet it can transfer calls to your team and connect to your field service software. Plans start from $87.50/mo at launch. [See Revo's plans](/pricing)

## Frequently asked questions
### Can the AI receptionist handle calls in Spanish?
Yes, calls are answered in both English and Spanish, following your script and instructions.
### Will the AI receptionist give quotes or assign technicians?
No, it does not provide quotes or assign technicians. It focuses on answering, booking, and messaging.
